A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. D sits second to the left of E. B sits fourth to the right of A. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. F sits to the immediate left of G and is not an immediate neighbour of B. How many people sit between A and E when counted from the left of A?1547

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.

Statement: Despite having favourable climatic conditions for banana farming, District A has not become a major centre for banana exports in the country.

Reasons:
I. The road infrastructure connecting District A to major ports and markets is inadequate.
II. District B already meets 50% of the country's banana export demand.
options: Both I and II are possible reasons.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Only I is a possible reason.) है।
